questions.questionText: OOP stands for

questions.explanation: The correct answer is D) Encapsulation. (Classes and Methods)

questions.explanation: The correct answer is B) encapsulation. (Classes and Methods)

questions.explanation: The correct answer is A) the class name. (Classes and Methods)
